title: Vanilla Essence
description: A Vanilla+ modpack, adding some QOL features and items that feel right at home within the game. Lightweight and easy to run!
body:
![Vanilla Essence logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bce83a0ef48dd275fb77cdc79df6bd7aaa5d8f19.png) # Vanilla Essence! ![Modrinth Downloads](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/dt/gGZTf1je?style=for-the-badge) ![Modrinth Followers](https://img.shields.io/modrinth/followers/gGZTf1je?style=for-the-badge) ## What is Vanilla Essence? Vanilla Essence is a new Fabric 1.21.1 Vanilla+ modpack, adding some features that feel right at home in the base game. Works in creative and survival, singleplayer and multiplayer. Quite lightweight, can run on pretty much any reasonably modern computer! ## What's included? Vanilla Essence includes many mods, adding to the vanilla experience.
Included mods These are some of the main mods in the pack:
  • HT's TreeChop
  • Copper Tools
  • Supplementaries
  • Fletching Expanded
  • Carry On
  • Connectible Chains
  • Xaero's Minimap & World Map
## Support ![GitHub Issues or Pull Requests](https://img.shields.io/github/issues/StikyPiston/VanillaEssence?style=for-the-badge) ![GitHub Discussions](https://img.shields.io/github/discussions/StikyPiston/VanillaEssence?style=for-the-badge) Issues with the pack can be reported [here](https://github.com/StikyPiston/VanillaEssence/issues). You can also discuss the pack, what you've made, suggestions, etc. [here](https://github.com/StikyPiston/VanillaEssence/discussions)!
